anomalies.observed: C59 is labelled 220p (220 pF) and sits between the magnetometer's C1 pin (pin 5) and GND. The same sheet also carries a note 'C59 ESR < 200mOhm', which describes a larger capacitor than a 220 pF part.
anomalies.expected: The IIS2MDCTR's C1 pin normally needs a 100 nF to 220 nF (not picofarad) capacitor to GND. The value should probably read 220n, consistent with the ESR note.

Magnetometer | NAVCPeripherals | ST IIS2MDCTR, I2C addr 0x1E

anomalies.impact: A 220 pF capacitor on C1 instead of the required nanofarad-range capacitor may leave the magnetometer's internal regulator/reference under-filtered, which could degrade magnetometer operation or cause instability.

parsed.summary: Most of the power, reset, boot, crystal, pull-up, LED and connector values I checked are consistent with the spec and each other, but the magnetometer C1 decoupling capacitor C59 is marked 220p, which is probably a unit error and is the only candidate anomaly I could support from the drawing.
